about_the_game:
The popular board game "Kushi Express" is coming to Table Party as a VR DLC! 🍢🔥

Use tomatoes, bell peppers, shrimp, beef, cheese, and bacon to quickly assemble skewers and claim victory.

In this immersive VR experience, you can physically grab ingredients and thread them onto skewers, feeling the satisfying motion firsthand!

As soon as an order card is revealed, players must race to complete the skewer in the correct order and composition.

The first player to place the correct skewer on the plate earns points, and the player with the most order cards wins the game.

We've taken the fun of the original board game and enhanced it with VR immersion!

Quick reflexes are key, but the faster you rush, the more likely you are to mix up the order of ingredients.

Stay swift yet precise—create the perfect skewer and become the ultimate master of Kushi Express! 🔥🎮
